ex.en: They argued over petty details and forgot the main issue.
ex.zh: 他们为琐碎的细节争吵，却忘了主要问题。

words.note: petty 指“琐碎的、小气的”，petty crime 指轻微犯罪。

ex.en: The candles glowed softly in the dark room.
ex.zh: 烛光在昏暗的房间里柔和地闪亮。

words.note: glow 指发出柔和稳定的光，也可指脸上泛红光。

ex.en: Public sentiment turned against the plan after the costs were revealed.
ex.zh: 成本公布后，公众情绪转而反对该计划。

words.note: sentiment 指情绪、看法；share the sentiment 表有同感。

ex.en: Clear product differentiation helps small firms survive in a crowded market.
ex.zh: 清晰的产品差异化有助于小公司在拥挤的市场中生存。

words.note: differentiation 指区分或差异化，动词为 differentiate。

ex.en: The country amended its constitution to protect the environment.
ex.zh: 该国修改宪法以保护环境。

words.note: constitution 除“宪法”外，还可指“体质”。

ex.en: The engineer applied for a patent on her new battery design.
ex.zh: 这位工程师为她的新电池设计申请了专利。

words.note: patent 作名词指专利，apply for a patent 表申请专利。

ex.en: Police seized a large amount of cocaine at the border.
ex.zh: 警方在边境查获了大量可卡因。

words.note: cocaine 为不可数名词；相关说法有 drug abuse。

ex.en: A deep groove had worn into the wooden floor.
ex.zh: 木地板上已经磨出了一道深槽。

words.note: groove 指细长凹槽；in the groove 表状态极佳。

ex.en: Fresh fruit is available in abundance during the summer months.
ex.zh: 夏季水果大量上市。

words.note: in abundance 与 an abundance of 均表“大量”。

ex.en: The children were making such a racket that I could not sleep.
ex.zh: 孩子们吵闹得那么厉害，我无法入睡。

words.note: racket 有三义：球拍、喧闹声、诈骗勾当。

ex.en: It is hard to conceive of a world without the internet.
ex.zh: 很难想象一个没有互联网的世界。

words.note: conceive of 表“想象、设想”，也可说 conceive a plan。

ex.en: The milk had gone sour by the time we got home.
ex.zh: 我们到家时牛奶已经变酸了。

words.note: go sour 既指食物变酸，也指事情变糟。

ex.en: The new railway transformed the small town into a busy commercial centre.
ex.zh: 新铁路把这座小镇变成了繁忙的商业中心。

words.note: transform 常与 into 连用，强调彻底改变。

ex.en: She wiped her mouth with a paper napkin and stood up to leave.
ex.zh: 她用纸餐巾擦了擦嘴，起身离开。

words.note: napkin 指餐巾，英式口语中有时说 serviette。

ex.en: Reckless driving is one of the main causes of road accidents.
ex.zh: 鲁莽驾驶是道路事故的主要原因之一。

words.note: reckless 指不顾后果的，常用 reckless driving。

ex.en: It is a paradox that such a rich country has so many poor people.
ex.zh: 如此富裕的国家却有这么多穷人，这真是个悖论。

words.note: paradox 指看似矛盾却可能正确的说法。

ex.en: Few people understood the magnitude of the disaster at first.
ex.zh: 起初很少有人明白这场灾难的严重程度。

words.note: magnitude 指巨大程度，也指地震震级。

ex.en: There is little justification for raising fees without warning students.
ex.zh: 事先不通知学生就涨学费，几乎没有正当理由。

words.note: justification 后接 for，动词 justify 表“证明正当”。

ex.en: She showed genuine interest in what the students had to say.
ex.zh: 她对学生们说的话表现出真正的兴趣。

words.note: genuine 指“真正的、真诚的”，反义 fake。

ex.en: The success of the project depended on the careful execution of the plan.
ex.zh: 项目的成功取决于计划的谨慎执行。

words.note: execution 指执行或处决；动词 execute 兼有两义。

ex.en: Most adults are immune to this childhood disease.
ex.zh: 大多数成年人对这种儿童疾病有免疫力。

words.note: immune to 后接名词，表“对…免疫、不受影响”。

ex.en: The tourist office gave us a brochure about local hiking trails.
ex.zh: 旅游局给了我们一本关于当地徒步路线的小册子。

words.note: brochure 指薄薄的宣传小册子，如 travel brochure。

ex.en: The teacher gave the noisy class a stern look.
ex.zh: 老师严厉地看了吵闹的班级一眼。

words.note: stern 指态度严厉，常用 stern look/warning。

ex.en: This machine converts rotary motion into electrical energy.
ex.zh: 这台机器把旋转运动转化为电能。

words.note: rotary 由 rotate 派生，表“旋转的”。

ex.en: A lack of sleep can compound the effects of stress.
ex.zh: 睡眠不足会加重压力的影响。

words.note: compound 作名词指化合物，作动词表“使恶化”。

ex.en: The city has been dubbed the cultural capital of the north.
ex.zh: 这座城市被称为北方的文化之都。

words.note: dub 常指给…起绰号或为影片配音，多用被动。

ex.en: The designer mixed masculine and feminine elements in her collection.
ex.zh: 这位设计师在系列中融合了男性与女性元素。

words.note: masculine 指“男性的、男子气的”，反义 feminine。

ex.en: Under extraordinary circumstances, the rule may be suspended.
ex.zh: 在特殊情况下，这条规定可以暂停执行。

words.note: extraordinary 由 extra-（超出）+ordinary 构成。

ex.en: Several passengers witnessed the accident from the bus.
ex.zh: 几名乘客从公交车上目睹了这起事故。

words.note: witness 作名词指证人，作动词指目击、见证。

ex.en: Conventional wisdom says that harder work always leads to better results.
ex.zh: 普遍看法认为更努力总会带来更好的结果。

words.note: conventional 指“传统的、常规的”，反义 unconventional。
